_note: Built dark (Priority Goal 1B, Phase 0, 2026-07-31) -- not yet linked from any public page. Launches (linked from the-receipts-standard/index.html and the README) the moment a real, voluntarily-published external manifest exists. Entries: name, manifest_url, added (date first listed), last_validated (date of the most recent validation run), last_conforming (the last date the manifest actually validated -- the public date, shown on signs and standing pages in every state), via (paid-audit|independent -- provenance, added 2026-08-01 alongside the Checkable Audit offer page, which publicly commits to disclosing whether a listed operator paid us to build their manifest; 'independent' means they adopted the standard without buying anything from us, and listing is never paid or pay-gated either way), status (conforming|failing|delisted per _policy below; failing entries also carry failing_since, delisted entries carry delisted). Schema bumped to 0.2 on 2026-08-02 with the three-state upgrade. Fields prefixed _unconfirmed are the retry-confirmation scratchpad and carry no public meaning.
_policy: Standing policy, identical for paying customers, free entries, and our own manifest. Every entry is revalidated daily by the reference validator (validate_manifest.py). A new failure is confirmed only after 3 failed fetches spread over at least 5 hours -- transient blips never flip public state. On confirmation the entry is marked failing with the date. After 14 consecutive confirmed-failing days it is marked delisted. Entries are never removed, only marked. Relisting is automatic on the next conforming validation and the lapse stays in public history. This policy is running code, not prose: standing.py in this repository is the single implementation, applied by one shared code path to everyone. Payment buys a hosted standing page and an alarm (Checkable Open, /open/). It never buys lenience, and the sign is not purchasable.
